text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza, I 
caught sight of Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. My shoes are in good shape, 
and my legs are warmed up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to wait for Air 
Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: High-Pitched Voices
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai, thank you for your hard 
work with the shoot~! Would you care for 
some tea?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I appreciate the thought, but I 
actually have a tandem training run 
scheduled right after this.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Senpai's running...! Um, um! We won't get 
in the way, so may we watch?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me... I make it a rule to run in 
an environment where maximum focus is 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If there is an opportunity to observe, I 
will let you know. So for this time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Senpai. I'm... fine with... having 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober! But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay. There's something I want to 
verify.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So... Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Go ahead and wait at the 
track. I will prepare immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
A tandem run between two of the academy's 
finest upperclasswomen! We need to get 
there quickly and snag good seats!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of holding back, 
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I have no intention of letting 
you pass me, either.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Bold words. I look forward to seeing 
just what kind of run you deliver.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they've started— ...Wait, that speed 
right from the start?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... Neither of them is giving 
up the lead...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh... I won't lose! Because my 
running isn't just this—)

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Go for it, Air Groove-senpai! —Do your 
best, Dober-senpaiii!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... No matter what wall it is! I'll 
overcome it... I'll show you I cannn!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...! ...In the end, I lost 
by seven lengths... huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Damn it. I... couldn't overcome 
it... again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, you certainly lived up to your bold 
claim. You gave me quite a scare for a 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So then. Did you find out what you 
wanted to confirm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I really am hopeless after all. Just 
running took everything I had, and the 
result was a total wreck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But—that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because this frustration... is surely 
proof that I'm moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Dober. You truly have changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...—Yes!
